characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: Consulting detective; brilliant reasoner and observer, central investigator in the narratives.
characters.scope: book

characters.name: Dr. John H. Watson
characters.description: Medical doctor, narrator and Holmes’ friend and companion.
characters.scope: book

characters.name: Irene Adler
characters.description: Operatic singer; the woman uniquely admired by Sherlock Holmes in 'A Scandal in Bohemia'.
characters.scope: A Scandal in Bohemia

characters.name: Wilhelm Gottsreich Sigismond von Ormstein
characters.description: Reigning Grand Duke / hereditary King of Bohemia; Holmes’ client in 'A Scandal in Bohemia'.
characters.scope: A Scandal in Bohemia

characters.name: Godfrey Norton
characters.description: English lawyer; admirer and later husband of Irene Adler in 'A Scandal in Bohemia'.
characters.scope: A Scandal in Bohemia

characters.name: John (coachman)
characters.description: Coachman employed locally who watches and reports movements in 'A Scandal in Bohemia'.
characters.scope: A Scandal in Bohemia

characters.name: Mrs. Hudson
characters.description: Landlady of Holmes and Watson's Baker Street lodgings.
characters.scope: book

characters.name: Mr. Jabez Wilson
characters.description: Portly pawnbroker; client in 'The Red-Headed League' whose odd employment leads to investigation.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Vincent Spaulding
characters.description: Assistant to Jabez Wilson; key local figure whose employment triggers the Red-Headed League plot.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Mr. Duncan Ross
characters.description: Manager figure presented as the Red-Headed League official; operator of the fake office in Fleet Street.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: William Morris
characters.description: Name given by landlord as having used a room (mentioned during the Red-Headed League investigation).
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: John Clay
characters.description: Professional criminal, leader of the gang that attempt the bank robbery in 'The Red-Headed League'.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Archie
characters.description: Companion/accomplice involved in the Red-Headed League tunnelling attempt (appears assisting John Clay).
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Peter Jones
characters.description: Police agent of Scotland Yard who assists in 'The Red-Headed League' case.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Mr. Merryweather
characters.description: Chairman / bank director (City branch) who participates in the bank-robbery plot investigation in 'The Red-Headed League'.
characters.scope: The Red-Headed League

characters.name: Miss Mary Sutherland
characters.description: Young woman who consults Holmes about the disappearance of Mr. Hosmer Angel in 'A Case of Identity'.
characters.scope: A Case of Identity

characters.name: James Windibank
characters.description: Mary Sutherland's stepfather who is revealed to have impersonated 'Hosmer Angel' in 'A Case of Identity'.
characters.scope: A Case of Identity

characters.name: Mr. Hosmer Angel
characters.description: Name of the man who courted Mary Sutherland and who turns out to be an impostor in 'A Case of Identity'.
characters.scope: A Case of Identity

characters.name: Mr. Lestrade
characters.description: Inspector from Scotland Yard; appears in several investigations (referred to or appearing).
characters.scope: book

characters.name: Mr. John Turner
characters.description: Large local landowner in Boscombe Valley; friend of McCarthy family; later confesses to killing Charles McCarthy in 'The Boscombe Valley Mystery'.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: Charles McCarthy
characters.description: Tenant of Hatherley Farm; the murdered man in 'The Boscombe Valley Mystery'.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: James McCarthy
characters.description: Son of Charles McCarthy and accused of his father's murder in 'The Boscombe Valley Mystery'.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: William Crowder
characters.description: Game-keeper employed by Mr. Turner who witnesses movements near Boscombe Pool.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: Patience Moran
characters.description: Daughter of the lodge-keeper of Boscombe Valley; eyewitness who hears quarrel beside the pool.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: Dr. Willows
characters.description: Local physician who attends in 'The Boscombe Valley Mystery' and comments on Turner's health.
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: John Openshaw
characters.description: Young man terrorized by warnings and orange pips; victim in 'The Five Orange Pips'.
characters.scope: The Five Orange Pips

characters.name: Captain James Calhoun
characters.description: Captain of the barque _Lone Star_, named in Holmes’ tracing of the Five Orange Pips senders.
characters.scope: The Five Orange Pips

characters.name: Major Prendergast
characters.description: Acquaintance who recommended Holmes to John Openshaw in 'The Five Orange Pips'.
characters.scope: The Five Orange Pips

characters.name: Isa Whitney
characters.description: Man addicted to opium; central to the opening of 'The Man with the Twisted Lip' (family name Whitney appears).
characters.scope: The Man with the Twisted Lip

characters.name: Kate Whitney
characters.description: Wife of Isa Whitney who seeks Holmes’ help in 'The Man with the Twisted Lip'.
characters.scope: The Man with the Twisted Lip

characters.name: Neville St. Clair
characters.description: Respectable gentleman who is found to be living as the beggar 'Hugh Boone' in 'The Man with the Twisted Lip'.
characters.scope: The Man with the Twisted Lip

characters.name: Hugh Boone
characters.description: Well-known professional beggar with a twisted lip who is revealed to be Neville St. Clair in 'The Man with the Twisted Lip'.
characters.scope: The Man with the Twisted Lip

characters.name: Lascar (opium den attendant)
characters.description: Lascar proprietor/attendant of the opium den where Holmes investigates 'The Man with the Twisted Lip'.
characters.scope: The Man with the Twisted Lip

characters.name: Peterson
characters.description: Commissionaire who finds Henry Baker’s hat and the goose in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: Henry Baker
characters.description: Owner (finder) of the battered hat connected to the blue carbuncle mystery in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: Countess of Morcar
characters.description: Owner of the famous blue carbuncle jewel that drives the investigation in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: John Horner
characters.description: Plumber accused of having stolen the blue carbuncle in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: James Ryder
characters.description: Hotel upper-attendant who is the actual thief in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'; confesses and is spared by Holmes.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: Breckinridge
characters.description: Covent Garden poultry salesman involved in the trace of the goose in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: Mrs. Oakshott
characters.description: Brixton Road poultry supplier whose account appears in the stall ledger in 'The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle

characters.name: Dr. Grimesby Roylott
characters.description: Violent, eccentric doctor of Stoke Moran responsible for the speckled band and the death in 'The Adventure of the Speckled Band'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Speckled Band

characters.name: Helen Stoner
characters.description: Visitor who seeks Holmes' help about her sister’s mysterious death in 'The Adventure of the Speckled Band'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Speckled Band

characters.name: Alice Turner
characters.description: Daughter of Mr. Turner (Boscombe Valley); involved in the Boscombe story (appears in The Boscombe Valley Mystery).
characters.scope: The Boscombe Valley Mystery

characters.name: Victor Hatherley
characters.description: Hydraulic engineer, victim of maiming and narrator of 'The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb

characters.name: Colonel Lysander Stark
characters.description: Thin, enigmatic American colonel who hires Hatherley and then attempts violence in 'The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb

characters.name: Mr. Ferguson
characters.description: Manager/associate of Colonel Stark mentioned during the hydraulic press episode in 'The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb

characters.name: Dr. Becher
characters.description: Local doctor mentioned in aftermath of the hydraulic press fire in 'The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Engineer’s Thumb

characters.name: Lord Robert Walsingham de Vere St. Simon
characters.description: Young nobleman whose bride disappears at their wedding in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

aliases.text: Lord Robert Walsingham de Vere St. Simon

characters.name: Miss Hatty Doran
characters.description: Bride who vanishes during her wedding breakfast; daughter of Aloysius Doran in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

characters.name: Aloysius Doran
characters.description: Father of Hatty Doran, American millionaire; present at the wedding in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

characters.name: Francis Hay Moulton
characters.description: American gentleman (Frank) who reveals the true cause of the bride’s disappearance in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

characters.name: Mrs. Francis Hay Moulton
characters.description: Mrs. Moulton (American) who tells the story of her flight and secret marriage in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

characters.name: Flora Millar
characters.description: Dancer ('_danseuse_') who creates a disturbance at the wedding and is briefly suspected of involvement in the bride’s disappearance in 'The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

characters.name: Alexander Holder
characters.description: Senior partner in Holder & Stevenson; banker who takes custody of the Beryl Coronet and suffers its partial mutilation in 'The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet

characters.name: Arthur Holder
characters.description: Alexander Holder’s son, initially suspected of mutilating and stealing three gems from the Beryl Coronet in 'The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet

characters.name: Mary Holder
characters.description: Alexander Holder’s niece; devoted to her uncle and central to family dynamics in 'The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet

characters.name: Sir George Burnwell
characters.description: Worldly, cynical man implicated as the person who obtains the stolen beryls in 'The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet

characters.name: Jephro Rucastle
characters.description: Sullen countryman who keeps his stepdaughter imprisoned in 'The Adventure of the Copper Beeches'; owner of the Copper Beeches.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Mrs. Rucastle
characters.description: Young stepmother of Alice Rucastle; married to Jephro Rucastle and devoted to her son in 'The Adventure of the Copper Beeches'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Alice Rucastle
characters.description: Jephro Rucastle’s daughter held captive in an upstairs room at the Copper Beeches; later rescued/eloped in the narrative.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Violet Hunter
characters.description: Young governess who is offered a mysterious position at the Copper Beeches and whose observations trigger the rescue in 'The Adventure of the Copper Beeches'.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Toller
characters.description: Drunken groom/servant at the Copper Beeches, who tends the mastiff dog; his inebriation is part of the household's control of others.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Mrs. Toller
characters.description: Toller’s wife, servant at the Copper Beeches, who knows details about the household and helps reveal the plot.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Carlo
characters.description: Large mastiff kept at the Copper Beeches used to intimidate and control intruders.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches

characters.name: Miss Stoper
characters.description: Manageress of Westaway’s governess agency in London who refers Violet Hunter to the Copper Beeches post.
characters.scope: The Adventure of the Copper Beeches
